All 9 tests now pass under `node --test`. I changed only the source files, not the tests.

**Bugs**
1. **`src/bill.js`, `splitBill`:** the leftover-cent check was `i <= leftover`, which gave one extra person a cent. It is now `i < leftover`. That is what broke the even split, the leftover-cents case and the total-preserved check.
2. **`src/duration.js`, `parseDuration`:** it matched `(\d+)([hms])` pieces anywhere in the string and ignored the rest. Input like `"10m and change"` was accepted as 600 seconds, and `"3d"` would have been read as just `3` if it had another valid piece. I added a check at the top that the whole string is one or more number-plus-unit pieces (`/^(\d+[hms])+$/`). Anything else throws `SyntaxError`.

I did the work directly and didn't delegate to any other backend.
